name: Propaya
long_description: Propaya uses AI to analyze commercial leases and transform them into structured, clause-cited insights, linked obligations, and export-ready data in minutes. Beyond lease review, Propaya’s Property Intelligence module helps identify environmental and biological property risks—such as mold, moisture, and indoor health concerns—using AI-assisted analysis and structured risk frameworks. Together, these tools help owners, brokers, asset managers, and attorneys make faster, better-informed leasing and portfolio decisions.
one_liner: AI lease review and property intelligence for commercial real estate
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate
